headline: Mandatory Mobile Registration Shifts Mexican Telecom Market Share
summary: The mandatory registration of cell phones in Mexico altered market distribution as Telcel, AT&T, and Movistar lost a combined 7.6 million lines while alternative operators gained ground.
why: Regulatory compliance mandates in telecommunications can disrupt subscriber counts and alter competitive market shares among carriers.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Mandatory mobile registration rules impact subscriber retention and market distribution for telecom operators.
